profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Hinge Health
profile.summary:
Software Engineer with 11+ years of experience in full-stack development and technical leadership. Polyglot with deep knowledge and hand-on experience with Javascript/Typescript, React, Ruby, Python, PHP, Scala, and Java.

I'm passionate about creating software with excellent user experience and scalable technologies. I embrace any opportunity to learn new concepts and create solutions to interesting problems. I leverage my multidisciplinary background in bioinformatics and chemistry to efficiently analyze large systems and design elegant software solutions.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: San Francisco, California, United States · Remote
positions.description:
* Rewards and Insights - Implemented mobile app features and led projects to increase user engagmenet in mobile app and increase positive outcomes of their digital physical therapy program.
* High-risk Members - Used react-native to implement custom in-app experiences and experiments for a subset of high-value members
* Targeted Interventions - Designed and implemented decision engine to drive custom in-app experiences for high-risk members, based on medical record analysis.
*  Applied Data and Integrations - Implemented a data ingestion system to store and analyze patient medical records.

* Assisted in the deconstruction of Ruby On Rails monolith into Typescript (NestJs) Microservices.
* Implemented observability with DataDog to improve OpEx of backend microservices.
* Worked with large React Native codebase (100+ screens). Implemented new screens/components, fixed bugs, added analytics event tracking, and feature flag gating.
* Debugged and fixed issues within a distributed system of 10+ backend micro-services (Typescript, Nest.js, sumologic)
* Wrote technical documents for proposed features and improvements. Discussed with several team to gain alignment on an approach that would meet business requirements in a technically safe and scalable manner.
positions.insights: Skills: Full-Stack Development · Ruby on Rails · TypeScript · Requirements Analysis · Technical Documentation · React Native · Artificial Intelligence (AI) · Software Project Management

positions.title: Director of Software Engineering
positions.description: Oversaw all aspects of SDLC for storm-water compliance platform with active and growing user-base. Interviewed, hired, and managed team consisting of engineering, design, dev ops, quality assurance, and project management professionals. Provided technical leadership and individual contributions to software product. Met with stakeholders to ideate new product capabilities. Created high-fidelity and implementation-ready designs in Figma. Implemented CI/CD pipeline for reliable, safe, and low-effort releases.

positions.title: Student Apprentice
positions.description: At UNM, Professor Cyman taught the traditional process from Arita, Japan for wheel-thrown porcelain pottery.  I learned to form, trim, paint, glaze, fire, photograph, and showcase porcelain pottery.  I appeared in exhibitions at the Wyreich Gallery in Albuquerque, NM and the Fuller Lodge Art Center in Los Alamos, NM.  In addition to learning the process of creating porcelain vessels, I learned about the role of art in Japanese culture and the histories of Arita, Japan and porcelain ceramics.

projects.title: Smithsonian Store Mobile Retrofit
projects.description:
I developed and implemented the mobile layouts for Smithsonian Store.  Originally, the website had a fixed-width layout and no support for screens smaller than about 1000px.  As a contractor for Bryte Studio, and in communication with Smithsonian Institution, I implemented CSS styles to accommodate small phones and tables.

This project was particularly challenging because one of the client's requirements was that we could only add styles to existing views; this meant that the server-side JSP templates had to remain intact. Furthermore, the Javascript code, which developed in 2005 was largely unmaintainable; this further constrained our options to only styling and very minimal scripting. Another major constraint was that the majority of the users of the website viewed the content using outdated browsers with poor support for modern CSS.  For these reasons, the project relied heavily on re-flowing content, overriding fixed-layout styles, and hiding content that could not be shown without scripting or modifying the templates.  In the end, the website presents a functional and aesthetically pleasing product browsing and shopping experience for users on any device.
